defect: #7872 resolves each runtime's pnl_currency from its single unambiguous ledger/position currency; probe:trading-pulse-operator still built expected PnL groups from raw telemetry pnl_currency, which is null on hosted, so every release failed five PnL checks.
reproduction: The old probe (dev f0a0eb79f) run on the new hosted-shape fixture returns exactly the five failures: pnl_group_denominator_mismatch, pnl_group_scope_mismatch, pnl_group_value_mismatch, ranking_denominator_mismatch:pnl, ranking_observation_coverage_mismatch:pnl. The changed probe passes the same fixture.

fix.currency_source: ledger_currency(raw, binding_id) reads the raw GET /api/v1/telemetry/{runtime_id}/summary record the probe already fetches. That route returns the same unprojected summary record that ManagementService.get_trading_pulse passes to _resolve_ledger_pnl_currency (store.get_telemetry_summary and list_telemetry_summaries share one DomainTelemetryPort source). The facts read are positions[].currency/pnl_currency/quote_currency (else the per-symbol map), _currency_by_symbol, binding-matched _marks_by_symbol quote currency, positions_by_underlying instruments, ledgers/constituent_ledgers/member_virtual_books, mark_refs, known binding-matched quarter_equity_observations at pnl_at (and their mark_refs), last_fill.currency, and declared currency/ledger_currency/account_facts.currency. The code is written independently in the probe; it does not import the BFF and never reads /bff/management/trading-pulse.
fix.single_mixed_unknown: One currency gives that currency. More than one currency, raw or ledger pnl_currency_status mixed, or an active position without a currency and no declared currency gives None, so the runtime stays out of expected pnl_groups and pnl ranking eligibility, as #7872 keeps pnl_currency null.
fix.raw_claim_rule: If raw pnl_currency (or metrics.pnl_currency) is present and any ledger/position fact names another currency, or a constituent ledger is mixed, the probe records the named failure raw_pnl_currency_ledger_mismatch. Case is normalised before comparing ('twd' agrees with 'TWD').
fix.uses_replaced: The expected group tuple, the group value/covered match and pnl ranking comparability now use the ledger currency instead of raw.get('pnl_currency'). No existing failure name, threshold or case was removed or loosened.

paper_pnl_emission.question: Do paper runtimes emit pnl only on fills (pnl_at 2026-11-23T23:34:52Z versus latest_report_at 2026-11-26T05:17Z)?
paper_pnl_emission.answer_from_code: Not only on fills. services/execution/lean_runtime/paper_runtime.py _maybe_emit_performance_snapshots runs on every poll, values the portfolio with this cycle's marks (max mark age PANTHEON_PERFORMANCE_MARK_MAX_AGE_SECONDS, default 172800 s), and emits pnl_snapshot only when the valuation sample changes (new mark as_of or new fill). If marks are older than the limit or missing, valuation.sample is None and nothing is emitted; if the sample is unchanged it reports performance_sample_unchanged. Heartbeats keep latest_report_at moving, so pnl_at can lag it by days.
paper_pnl_emission.hosted_measurement: not measured (no hosted access, see hosted_run). The 2.2-day gap is consistent with marks older than 48 h or unchanged marks; which one applies needs the hosted performance_telemetry status.

residual_findings.finding: Possible stale PnL shown as current: the pulse groups a runtime whose pnl_at is days behind latest_report_at unless the raw summary marks it stale (staleness.is_stale/status/age_seconds). The probe applies the same rule, so it cannot show whether the page labels a 2-day-old PnL as current. Needs the hosted row (performance_context.pnl_at, staleness) to confirm.
